rationale: Constrained decoding is the highest-scoring isolated change and removes format-budget exits. Alignment has a directly observed syntax rejection and successful raw-code patch dispatches, while the file-version guard addresses the original legitimate-reread stop. Requirement checks are tested next behind the working protocol because their isolated run reached its finish gate only once, blocked by a missing requirements artifact. Targeted repair is added last to test residual token-cutoff recovery. Each successive candidate adds only one feature; no agent implementation changes are permitted.
selection: Report every candidate. Select highest pass count; break ties by fewer parse errors, then fewer total provider-reported tokens, then lower task wall time. A win requires at least six of ten tasks, not merely valid JSON.
limitations: Combination selection is on the development suite. No hidden grader content is inspected or used. These configurations were declared before any combination was scored.
factual_correction: Corrected the finish-gate description after counting trace events. One attempt was blocked for a missing artifact; there were no successful checks. Candidate configurations, order, selection rule and frozen implementation are unchanged. The original declaration is preserved in phase2-combination-plan-original.json.
